第25章 狗拿耗子少多管闲事（第1页）
杜飛瞥了眼黑衣青年受伤的手，眼底浮出一丝厌恶之意，“废物，居然被一个新生给伤了！”
交手那一刹，他就知道了叶凡实力。
自己灵武境六阶修为，完全不是对手。
杜飛冷斥一声，目光逼视向修炼室大门，“据我所知，这界新生中最厉害的，就是沐坚导师新收弟子聂霖吧？你有跟他说，这间修炼室我预约了吗？”
杜飛瞪向黑衣青年，“你确定吗？”
“聂霖我见过，不会认错。”黑衣青年道。
杜飛怒极而笑，“如果是聂霖，他也就算了。沐坚导师的弟子，该给个面子。没想到除聂霖外，居然还有其他新生这么狂？
闵浩不敢不给杜飛面子，“你杜飛要我帮忙，我肯定帮，就是不知要帮什么忙？”
杜飛抬手指向叶凡所在那间修炼室，冷声道，“待会儿里面的人出来，留住他。”
杜飛冷哼一声，迈步走向闵浩刚出来的那间修炼室，根本不怕闵浩不答应。
打算利用此地环境，冲击灵武境八阶。
杜飛从修炼室出来，见闵浩和黑衣青年还在，却不见叶凡，脸色瞬间沉了下来，“闵浩！那新生呢？”
杜飛怒喝道，“这新生比我先进修炼室！一刻钟时间已到，他敢不出来？”
外院学员入丹火塔修炼室内修炼，全靠自觉。
规定一天只能修炼多久，到点就必须离开。
否则轻则被罚积分，重则被列入黑名单。

闵浩无奈摊手，“这新生，该不会是个愣头青，不知道丹火塔修炼室的规矩吧？”
杜飛见闵浩这般笃定，幸灾乐祸，“那我就在这多等他一会儿，看他到时候怎么死！”

Chapter 25: Don’t mess with dogs and mind other people’s business (Page 1)
Du Fei glanced at the injured hand of the young man in black, with a hint of disgust in his eyes, "Trash, he was actually injured by a new student!"
The moment they fought, he knew Ye Fan's strength.
With his sixth level cultivation in the Spiritual Martial Realm, he is no match for him.
Du Fei scolded coldly and stared at the door of the training room, "As far as I know, the most powerful new student in this world is Nie Lin, the new disciple of Master Mu Jian, right? Have you told him that I have made a reservation for this training room?"
Du Fei glared at the young man in black, "Are you sure?"
"I've seen Nie Lin before, and I won't admit his mistake." The young man in black said.
Du Fei laughed angrily, "If it's Nie Lin, let him forget it. Mentor Mu Jian's disciples should be given some face. I didn't expect that besides Nie Lin, there would be other freshmen so crazy?
Min Hao didn't dare not give Du Fei face, "If Du Fei wants me to help, I will definitely help, but I don't know what kind of help I want to help? "
Du Fei raised his hand and pointed to the training room where Ye Fan was, and said coldly, "The people inside will come out later and keep him. "
Du Fei snorted coldly and walked towards the training room where Min Hao had just come out, not afraid that Min Hao would not agree.
He plans to use the environment here to attack the eighth level of the Lingwu Realm.
Du Fei came out of the training room and saw that Min Hao and the young man in black were still there, but not Ye Fan. His face instantly darkened, "Min Hao! What about freshmen? "
Du Fei shouted angrily, "This new student is in the training room before me! The quarter hour is up, does he dare to come out? "
Students from the outer academy enter the Alchemy Fire Tower to practice indoors, and they all rely on self-awareness.
It is stipulated how long you can only practice in a day, and you must leave when the time is up.
Otherwise, you may be fined points, or you may be blacklisted.
Min Hao spread his hands helplessly, "Isn't this new student a stupid young man who doesn't know the rules of the Danhuo Tower training room? "
Seeing Min Hao's determination, Du Fei gloated, "Then I'll wait for him here for a while and see how he dies! "
